name: Sherrill Mundy Lineberger, Sr.
bio: Known as Snooky. Married Eleanor Elizabeth Simmons on December 21, 1935, in Charlotte, Mecklenburg County, NC. Per the 1940 U.S. Census: head of household in Township 6, Shelby, Cleveland County, North Carolina, residing at the same place since 1935. Registered for military service in 1946. Died May 14, 1969, in Shelby, Cleveland County, NC, at age 54, and was buried in Sunset Cemetery, Shelby, NC.
